full_judgment: 3. The pre-emptee-opposite party No. 1, entered appearance in the pre-emption case and filed written statement denying most of the allegations of the pre-emption application stating, inter-alia, that the pre-emption case is not maintainable in its present form and manner inasmuch as, the pre-emptee-opposite party pursuant to the impugned kabala No.2763 dated 13-8-2000 did not acquire any right and title over the land under pre-emption. After filing the written statement the pre-emptee-opposite party filed an application for local investigation on 25-9-2007 by survey knowing Senior Advocate for ascertaining RS, CS and BS khatian of the case land.
